This land is not mine, I only rent it, so I cannot put too much money into it. Beans do not need fertilizer like maize does — my mother taught me that beans feed the soil themselves. I will use the seed I saved from last season, and my two older children will help me weed. If aphids come badly I may buy a small packet of chemical from the trading centre, but only if I see them eating the leaves.
